items.t: Head or intake gasket failure and overheating
items.job: Replace head gaskets/intake gaskets on 3.4L V6
items.note: CarComplaints lists typical costs of $870–$1,360; warped heads raise the price.

items.t: Heater blows only cold air
items.job: Replace temperature blend door (dash partly removed)
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $840.

items.t: Under-hood fuse block can melt
items.job: Replace under-hood fuse block and repair wiring
items.note: Reported costs range from about $1,500 to $2,750.

items.t: Cooling fan stops from melted connectors
items.job: Repair cooling fan connectors and wiring

items.t: Spark plug wires fail and cause misfires
items.job: Replace spark plug wires and spark plugs
items.note: Owners report about $700 at a shop. Rear plugs on the V6 take extra time.

items.t: Timing chain wear on the 3.6L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Labor is high because the engine front must come apart.

items.t: Power steering cuts out
items.job: Diagnose and replace electric power steering motor/column
items.note: One dealer quoted $2,200 for full replacement; used parts cost less.

items.t: StabiliTrak and traction control lights come on
items.job: Scan all modules and replace failed sensor
items.note: One owner was quoted $390 just for dealer diagnosis.

items.t: ABS activates at low speed from a bad wheel sensor
items.job: Replace ABS wheel speed sensor
items.note: One owner paid C$611 for a rear sensor at a shop.

items.t: Battery dies early or drains
items.job: Replace battery and test charging system
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $140.

items.t: Door wiring breaks and windows or locks stop working
items.job: Repair or replace door wiring harness

items.t: Alternator failure
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: AWD driveshaft center bearing or U-joint wear
items.job: Replace driveshaft center bearing and U-joints

items.t: AWD warning light in cold weather
items.job: Diagnose AWD system

items.t: Transmission cooler lines leak
items.job: Replace transmission cooler lines and top off fluid

items.t: Wheel bearing and hub failure
items.job: Replace wheel hub bearing assembly
items.note: Price is per wheel; one owner paid C$900 for both rears.

items.t: Front lower control arm rattle
items.job: Replace front lower control arm

items.t: Check engine light from gas cap or EVAP leak
items.job: Replace gas cap or EVAP sensor
items.note: A gas cap is cheap; one owner paid $600 for an EVAP sensor and pigtail.

items.t: Fuel smell or leak at the tank
items.job: Repair fuel tank leak or replace fuel pump module
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,200.

items.t: Corroded fuel lines leak
items.job: Replace corroded fuel lines

items.t: Water collects in the spare tire well
items.job: Water test and reseal rear leak

items.t: Side moldings peel off
items.job: Reattach or replace side moldings
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $500.

items.t: Airbag light from passenger seat sensor
items.job: Replace passenger occupant sensor

items.t: Roof rail airbags may not protect fully (recall)
items.job: Recall repair (07V-520)

items.t: Windshield may not stay attached in a crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reinstall windshield (recall 07V-242)

items.t: Passenger airbag status may be wrong (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate passenger seat sensor (recall 07V-344)

items.t: Squeaky serpentine belt
items.job: Replace serpentine belt
